claims.text: On 2026-08-30, the current GBA public home visibly listed `Trade License` and `Trade License Renewal` in its e-Services section.
claims.notes: Direct current observation of the unauthenticated public home. A service label does not establish that a live application route is available.

claims.text: The current GBA Trade License and Trade License Renewal cards render as non-link cursor-pointer containers without an href, and clicking either leaves the visitor at `https://bbmp.gov.in/home` without exposing a trade application form or trade-specific controls.
claims.notes: The click was navigation-only and did not submit data. This records the observed current fallback, not a universal assertion that no other authorised route exists.

claims.text: The current GBA public home displays general recovery contacts `Helpline: 1533` and `comm@bbmp.gov.in`; the page does not identify either as a Trade License-specific case handler.
claims.notes: General contact details are a possible recovery lead only; no message or call was made.

claims.text: The legacy public Trade License FAQ route `https://site.bbmp.gov.in/tradelicensefaq.html` returned a browser error stating `This site can’t be reached`, `site.bbmp.gov.in refused to connect`, and `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`.
claims.notes: Direct unauthenticated navigation on 2026-08-30. The visible Reload control was not activated.

claims.text: The legacy public new-registration guide route `https://site.bbmp.gov.in/PDF/trade%20license/NewTrade_Payment.pdf` returned a browser error stating `This site can’t be reached`, `site.bbmp.gov.in refused to connect`, and `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`.
claims.notes: Direct unauthenticated navigation on 2026-08-30. No guide controls, document checklist, OTP or payment control could be observed.

claims.text: The legacy public OTLS description route `https://site.bbmp.gov.in/departmentwebsites/BBMPIT/OTLS.html` returned a browser error stating `This site can’t be reached`, `site.bbmp.gov.in refused to connect`, and `ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED`.
claims.notes: Direct unauthenticated navigation on 2026-08-30. No inspection, review or licence-output controls could be observed.

claims.text: The reviewed current public GBA path does not reach a login, OTP, applicant form or other authenticated boundary, so the authentication prerequisite and any post-authentication controls are Unknown.
claims.notes: No attempt was made to bypass the missing route or authenticate.

claims.text: Because no public application route was reached, current document validation, fees, payment, receipt, inspection, review, status, approval, renewal result and issued licence are Unknown; no case state exists.
claims.notes: No login, applicant identifier, document, OTP, payment, submission, inspection or status lookup was performed.
